question: Does HDC case retrieval, added to the detector as a disagreeing stack member, raise pooled out-of-fold AUROC on the fixed CinC dev benchmark?

member.bank: training folds only: up to 8 evenly spaced hours per patient + up to 8 of each septic patient's positive hours
member.vote: similarity-weighted (relu cosine) mean of the k nearest bank hours' labels

combiner: per fold k: logistic regression on [logit(baseline OOF), z-scored member OOF] fitted on the other two folds' out-of-fold rows only, applied to fold k; pooled
primary_endpoint: delta pooled AUROC (baseline + member) - (baseline), primary baseline; paired patient bootstrap, 1000 draws; Bonferroni over the 4 variants (98.75% interval). SUCCESS iff the corrected lower bound > 0 for at least one variant.
secondary: the same against the shipped detector
delta detection at a 15% false-alarm budget (paired patient bootstrap)
Spearman rank correlation of the member with the primary baseline

controls.oracle: member = label + N(0,1) noise must come out significant (the test can succeed)
controls.noise: member = N(0,1) must NOT come out significant (the combiner cannot manufacture a gain)

disclosures: Before registering, a smoke test scored standalone AUROC of the flat and segmented members on 20,000 rows of fold 0 (hour vote 0.737 / 0.731, patient vote 0.751 / 0.745). No combination result has been computed.
rules: No parameter above changes after results are seen; anything further is labelled exploratory.
The result is reported whatever it is.
